answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 49532 Country: India Title: Zakah Question: A widow house maid has been given Rs 1 Lakh 35 thousand to give lease amount to the land lord, for the house she stays, and she gives minimum rent. Is she liable for zakah for next year? Answer ID: 49532 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 41/41/M=01/1435) If the said widow owns wealth equal to nisab after excluding the necessary expenses and the debt then she shall not be eligible for zakah and zakah cannot be given to her. What is the total wealth the widow owns? If it is known then her eligibility and ineligibility may be confirmed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
